title: Add deterministic mechanics for SRD adventuring gear and consumables
description:
Finding sources:
- ChatGPT and Codex identified many equipment records with gameplay effects but no typed mechanics.
- Codex readiness reported 101 equipment records prose-only or likely mechanically incomplete.
- Examples: acid, alchemist's fire, antitoxin, ball bearings, caltrops, healer's kit, holy water, hunting trap, net, oil, basic poison, potion of healing, rope, torch.

Acceptance criteria:
- Inventory all adventuring gear/equipment records with gameplay effects.
- Add typed mechanics for damage, saves/DCs, areas, durations, conditions, healing, light, restraints, traps, poison, consumable/application behavior, and tool interactions where present.
- Preserve existing equipment grouping/filter semantics.
- Tests cover representative damage, healing, area-control, light, trap, poison, restraint, and consumable cases.
notes:
Scope clarification (2026-07-06, from 18.7.8 rule classification, artifact §3 family 12): this bead explicitly owns the PER-RECORD deterministic payloads from the weapon/armor rule records — net (restrained, DC 10 Str escape, AC 10 / 5 slashing destroys, one-attack limit), lance (disadv within 5 ft, two-handed unmounted), improvised-weapon defaults (1d4, range 20/60), and per-armor Str-threshold/stealth/AC data alignment. Generic weapon-property semantics (finesse/heavy/loading/reach/thrown/versatile meaning, non-proficiency penalties, ammunition recovery) are NOT this bead — they are engine procedures tracked under eshyra-o9bd.18.7.8.3.
2026-07-08 ADR 0017 adjustment: Scope is pack-side equipment semantics and explicit runtime ownership hooks, not a private equipment engine. For each equipment clause, decide whether it is structural parsing, shared semantic grammar, curated spec, model-adjudicated-supported, or engine-pending. Arithmetic, dice, HP/temp-HP, conditions, action economy, and state transitions should bind to shared F-family owners where applicable.
close_reason: Corrected external-row required representation by reviewed owner category and pinned representative audit rows.
